How to play

  • 🧟 Zombies walk the roads to your castle, round after round. Every zombie that gets in costs the castle lives (❤️). Hold out for 100 rounds, then keep going!
  • 🔨 Build towers beside the roads with your coins (🪙) and wood (🪵) or stone (🪨). Barricades and spike traps go on the road itself.
  • 🪓 Walk into trees to chop wood and into rocks to mine stone (your crew shares them). Upgrades need them too. Trees and rocks grow back after a few rounds.
  • ⬆️ Tap a tower to upgrade it. Each tower has two paths: one path can go all the way to step 3, the other then stops at step 1. You can also change what it aims at, or sell it.
  • 🔥 Every tower and weapon hits with an element: 💪 physical, 🔥 fire, ❄️ ice, 💧 water, ⚡ lightning, 💥 blast, ✨ light, ☠️ poison or 🌪️ wind. Zombies are hurt more by some and shrug off others: fire melts frosties, water puts out blazes, light burns ghosts and shadows, bombs and lightning get through armour. Tap a zombie, or look in the 📖 Zombie book.
  • 🦇 Fliers (ghosts, bats, balloons, gargoyles, vultures) float over barricades and traps. Cannons, mortars, glue, mushrooms and geysers hit only walkers (GROUND); rockets hit only fliers (AIR). Diggers tunnel under the road: a geyser flushes them out. Shadows need a Ninja, a Lantern or shadow sight.
  • 🔫 Your weapon fires by itself (🥊 boxing gloves punch!). It levels up from the zombies you finish off, and every 5 levels it becomes something new.
  • ⭐ From round 50 zombies come as glowing elites, and from round 80 as golden champions: fewer of them, but much tougher, and worth more coins.
  • 🕹️ Drag the left part of the screen to walk (or W A S D and the arrow keys). You can walk through your towers.
  • ▶ Speed the game up with the 1× button. 👫 Play with friends: one hosts and shares the code.

📖 Zombie book

Every tower and weapon hits with an element. Each zombie is hurt by some and tough against others.
